name: Ark
blurb: Ark is a graphical file compression/decompression utility with support for multiple formats, including tar, gzip, bzip2, rar and zip, as well as CD-ROM images.
description:
Ark is a graphical file compression/decompression utility with support for multiple formats,
including tar, gzip, bzip2, rar and zip, as well as CD-ROM images.
Ark can be used to browse, extract, create, and modify archives.

Features:

• Several formats supported: gzip, bzip2, zip, rar, 7z and more

• Preview file contents without extracting files

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
